Job Description

Why considering joining us?

Joining us as a graduate is the next step in starting your career. Whether you’re coming from a specialist background or from an unrelated subject, we want you to be bold, stay curious and dive into the opportunities we have to offer. 

Within the Software and AI Systems team: 

  • We design and build software for real products and devices – some of the most innovative and life-changing imaginable.  
  • We develop software close to the hardware, from bare-metal and RTOS-based embedded systems, through machine control and industrial automation, to embedded Linux and desktop applications that manage and interact with connected devices. 
  • We love a challenge and the ability to use our technical know-how and innovative thinking to find the best answers.   
  • Our multi-disciplinary teams specialise in developing end-to-end products and devices, taking early-stage concepts through to complete product releases - and even to small volume production line scale-up.

Essential requirements

  • Qualification: Undergraduate degree — studying towards, or completed a STEM related degree   
  • Coding experience –  Proficient programming skills, with experience in any of these languages: C++, Python, Rust, C or C#.  Or significant experience in multiple other similar languages with a desire to learn. 
  • Growth-oriented and curious — open to change, driven to succeed, hungry for new challenges, and eager to broaden your understanding of the world apply new technical skills and rapidly acquire domain expertise. You will be able to think creatively and laterally, applying existing knowledge to new problems  
  • Collaborative and relationship-focused — thrive in dynamic teams, build strong relationships with clients and peers, and support others to succeed. 
  • Credible and communicative — comfortable in high-performance environments, with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.  
  • Analytical and adaptable — demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities, innovative thinking, and the flexibility to adapt your style and approach. You will apply your engineering experience and knowledge gained through university, work or projects to help develop solutions to real-world problems 
  • Professional and reliable — show strong workplace etiquette by being punctual, dependable, and respectful of business expectations and office conduct. 

Additional technical experience – the following will also be beneficial but not essential:  

  • Familiarity with software development practices and tools, such as agile, version control, TDD, CI and virtualisation 
  • Experience in AI engineering or Agent design 
  • Commercial experience in software design, development or testing   
  • Knowledge or experience of a specific area of interest, for example: embedded software, sensors, IoT, cloud, robotics, VR/AR 

What you can expect

Some examples of our work are: 

Software for Real Devices  

We are experts in developing best-in-class embedded software and firmware for cutting-edge products and devices across many industries, from small medical devices to large transport networks. For example, we developed the Oakdoor™ Data Diode to keep organisations safe from cyber-attacks. We have been working with Ori Biotech to accelerate the development of affordable cell and gene therapies, which is set to revolutionise the healthcare industry.  

Cloud Integration and IoT Devices  

We design and develop edge-processing software for embedded and bare-metal IoT devices, with cloud-integration as a key feature, to create end-to-end IoT solutions that have real business value. We work closely with our teams of digital engineers and data scientists to extract deeper insights from our data. We helped Water Source create a water purification system that can change the way people around the world access safe drinking water.  

Advanced Image processing & Virtual Reality   

We have expertise in high-speed image analysis and processing, as well as building systems that capture, interpret and use image data. We have built mixed-reality digital twins to improve how operators visualise information and remotely control hazardous systems. Using Microsoft’s HoloLens, we enhanced training modules for IMI Critical Engineering with augmented reality (AR) to give engineers a real-world experience of the products they’ll be maintaining.  

Assessment process

First Stage Assessments:

  • Application form.
  • Online Assessments.
  • Technical Assessment.

Final Stage Assessments:

  • In Person Assessment Centre with Technical Assessments.

Adjustments or accommodations - Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us on earlycareers@paconsulting.com

The Offer

  • Opportunity to write software for:  Embedded devices, Cloud Integration, IoT, Advanced Image processing, VR andSafety Critical Software for Medical Devices, Defence, Transport etc. 
  • Work on meaningful projects with talented people across a wide range of assignments  
  • Collaborate with talented, multi-disciplinary teams that provide insight into best practice software product development 
  • Your work will be based in our Global Technology and Innovation Centre in Melbourn. 
  • Salary potential: £31,000
  • This role will start in Autumn 2027 

A career at PA is what you make of it — so power your curiosity and prepare to make an impact. 

We’re committed to advancing equality. Can I use AI to apply?

At PA, we use AI tools on a daily basis. However, we value transparency and authenticity above all in our hiring process. We want to get know you, your skills, and experience in our interview process.

As such, we ask that no AI tools (including AI note takers, meeting assistants, and similar tools) are used by candidates during interview sessions. If AI tools are used during an interview, it could influence the outcome of your application.
